content: Piano pedagogy sources converge on: 5min warmup/stretching, daily scales (major/minor) plus Hanon-style dexterity exercises, 5-10min sight-reading at a slow fixed metronome tempo, repertoire learned hands-separately then combined at a mistake-free slow tempo before speeding up, and dedicated ear-training (interval/chord ID via apps like EarMaster) alongside singing to internalize pitch relationships. ~30-60min/day sessions recommended, 1-2 new pieces/week pace.
